data.value: Novice: only changes that cannot break anything. Expert: everything, including what is not recommended.

data.value: Three quick choices before you start. You can change them later in Settings.

data.value: Novice (recommended): PCDoc only offers changes that cannot break anything.

data.name: FirstRun.ModeExpert
data.value: Expert: everything is shown, including risky changes.

data.value: Off: Windows cannot create restore points. Turning it on is recommended.

data.name: Setup.Intro
data.value: For a new or freshly installed PC: everything that should be done, in the right order, in one go. A restore point is created first and every action is written to the report.

data.name: Setup.Software
data.value: Software to install (free, from official sources, silently)

data.name: Setup.Analyzing
data.value: Analyzing the PC… Windows Update can take a few minutes.

data.name: Setup.Done
data.value: Preparation finished. Export the report from History, and restart the PC if updates ask for it.

data.name: Setup.privacy.Explanation
data.value: Recommended profile: telemetry reduced, advertising and suggestions off, no more apps installed by themselves.

data.name: Setup.security.Explanation
data.value: Firewall, UAC, AutoRun, SmartScreen, antivirus definitions and other safe fixes (the others stay on the Security page).

data.name: Setup.optimize.Explanation
data.value: Settings of the chosen profile (power plan, game mode, start-up delay…).

data.name: Setup.bloatware.Explanation
data.value: Removes the useless apps added by Microsoft or the manufacturer (only the safe ones in novice mode).

data.name: Setup.windows.Explanation
data.value: Security and quality updates from Windows Update (drivers in expert mode).

data.name: Setup.software.Explanation
data.value: Updates installed software through winget, then installs the software chosen below.

data.name: Setup.cleanup.Explanation
data.value: Frees space first: temporary files, caches, error reports (files from the last 24 hours are kept). Cookies and history are only cleaned from the Cleanup page.

data.value: Save your choices (steps, use, software) under a name, then pick the profile on the next PC. In portable mode the profiles travel with PCDoc on the USB drive.

data.name: Maintenance.Intro
data.value: Once a week, PCDoc cleans, updates and scans the PC by itself, without any window, then writes a report (History). Only safe actions, with a restore point. The UAC is asked only once, now.

data.value: Install Windows updates (and Microsoft Store apps)

data.value: Quick Microsoft Defender scan, then an AdwCleaner adware search (detection: its report is in History).
